mapper.update: UPDATE content SET content = #{content}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE content SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, content, category_code AS categoryCode, remark, is_pinned AS pinned, copy_count AS copyCount, last_copy_time AS lastCopyTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM content WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE content SET copy_count = copy_count + 1, last_copy_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, content, category_code AS categoryCode, remark, is_pinned AS pinned, copy_count AS copyCount, last_copy_time AS lastCopyTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND last_copy_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_copy_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
